resources.string: Engine state, today\u2019s P&L and a kill switch
Not enough points for a chart yet.
Live is disarmed and has to be armed again from its checklist. %1$s
Battery optimisation can pause the engine while the screen is off. Tap to exempt Marketbot.
No API keys yet. Paper mode works without them; add keys under Accounts to see balances and trade live.
Kill switch: cancel every order and stop live trading
Why the last pass traded what it did
A KILL on the live record disarms live trading automatically; it continues in paper.
Paper checks are information only: they never disarm anything.
How often orders filled on markets that went against them, against markets that did not (%1$s record). A penalty above 1 means fills arrive when they hurt.
Grey until a band has 5 losing markets: fewer is noise.
Money tied up by resting orders and held positions: resting orders lock the full order, filled ones what filled, until settlement.
Once a day, the app compares its realised P&L on every settled Kalshi market with Kalshi\'s own settlement figure. Kalshi\'s is the true one.
Not run yet. It runs each morning while the engine is on and a Kalshi key is set.

Kalshi itself cancels the app\'s resting orders on a shard, and refuses new ones, when more than this many contracts fill within 15 seconds: a burst of fills is how the losing ones arrive. It works even if this phone is off. 0 turns it off.
Shard %1$d tripped %2$s: Kalshi refuses new orders there.
Could not set up the limit at Kalshi, so orders go without it: %1$s

Every 5 minutes while anything is live, the app compares the orders it thinks are resting with what Kalshi and Polymarket say, corrects its record from theirs, and warns about orders in its markets that it did not place.

A phone that crashed cannot warn you. Create a free check at healthchecks.io (or ntfy, Uptime Kuma) with a 15-minute period and paste its ping address: the app pings it every 5 minutes while the engine runs, with no data, and the service alerts you when the pings stop. If you stop the engine on purpose, pause the check too.
No settled record yet in this app.

Average gain per contract if each filled position were marked at the mid this long after the app saw the fill. Steadily negative means fills come when they hurt, visible within the hour instead of at settlement.
How often the markets this strategy quoted settled YES, against the probability their price gave at the time.
Ratio = settled YES / priced. Below 1 at low prices is the favourite-longshot bias paying; coloured once a bucket has 30 markets. Research = the weatherbot strict sample.
No locks. A protection that fires adds one here, with its reason and when it lifts.
Each pauses new orders for a while when its condition holds; exits and cancels continue. None has been measured on these strategies, so all start off: try one in paper first.
With safety notifications off, you will not hear about kills, brakes or a tripped fill limit.
From this app\'s live orders. The reward farm keeps its own book: its positions show under Accounts.
New orders paused until %1$s. Resting orders, fills and settlements carry on.
Record every API request and response (never keys or signatures) to share when something looks wrong.
Tags show where each number came from.
Every resting order of every strategy is cancelled at the exchange and live trading is disarmed. Filled positions are kept and settle normally.
Tap for the figures and where they came from
Keys are encrypted with a key held in the phone\'s secure hardware and never leave the device except to sign requests. Paper mode needs no keys.
Create one at kalshi.com > Account > API keys. You get a key id and a private key file (.pem).
BTC deep-ITM trades on Kalshi\'s crypto shard (index 2), which needs its own cash.
Create one at polymarket.us/developer after finishing KYC. The secret is shown once.

Some phones (Samsung, Xiaomi, OnePlus) also kill background apps in their own battery manager; set Marketbot to Unrestricted there. Keep the phone charging and on Wi-Fi for BTC deep-ITM, which re-quotes every few seconds.
Orders, fills and settlements are kept forever; they are the record. Routine activity lines are deleted after 14 days automatically.
Strategies are ports of pokeehokee/weatherbot and pokeehokee/polymarket, tested against the original Python on recorded inputs.

The latest reading of every value the app has used, where it came from and how old it is. Exchange values are always preferred; CALC means the API has no field for it and the formula is shown. Tap a value to see its origin; Find shows the activity lines that used it.
Nothing read yet. Values appear once a strategy runs or you refresh balances.
Defaults are the measured values from the original repos. A dot marks a changed setting.
No money limits to show for this strategy.
Leave without saving the changed settings?
No live accounts connected. Paper results below.
Realised only: settled positions, from the exchange\'s settlement figures (live) or the simulator (paper).
Every gate passed: this strategy has earned a look at live money. Going live still needs its checklist, a preflight and your confirmation.
%1$d of %2$d gates passed. Gates: four weeks of paper, 100+ settled fills, 10+ losses, losses at most 0.90 of implied, and a positive record per contract.
Kill switch: cancel every resting order and stop live trading
One point an hour; %1$d of the last %2$d hours had a reading of their own (the others carry the previous value). Readings are taken while the engine runs.
No live account readings yet. Connect Kalshi or Polymarket under Accounts; the engine then records the balance every 15 minutes.
Needs at least two settled %1$s positions.
Top line: expected (%1$s). Bottom: this app\'s record.
Swipe a resting live order left to cancel it.
It runs trading strategies on Kalshi and Polymarket from this phone, around the clock, the way they ran on a desktop.
Every number shows where it came from: the exchange (KALSHI / POLYMARKET), a calculation (CALC), the simulator (PAPER) or your settings. Tap a number for the exact field or formula.
Your keys stay on this phone and are only used to sign requests to the exchanges.
Paper first, real money only on purpose
Everything starts in paper mode: live public prices, simulated orders, nothing sent to an exchange.
Live trading needs a checklist, a preflight, typing LIVE and your fingerprint or screen lock, per strategy.

These strategies win small and often and lose big and rarely: one contract can lose up to about a dollar. Only the weather longshot has made money live, and its last stage check failed. Each card says how strong its evidence is.
Run one bot per account. If a computer is trading the same account, stop it first.
I understand this can lose money
Paper mode needs no keys. Keys let the app show your balances and, when you arm it, trade.
Kalshi: kalshi.com > Account > API keys gives a key id and a .pem file. Its private key goes into this phone\'s secure hardware and cannot be read back out.

Start the weather longshot in paper: it sells cheap YES on Kalshi\'s daily temperature buckets and is the one method with a live record. You\'ll see its first simulated offers on the next hourly pass.
A phone pauses background apps to save battery. Three settings stop that from pausing your strategies.
Each starts in paper. Live needs its checklist, a preflight and your confirmation.
%1$s has changed settings that are not saved.
The engine is off, so nothing runs. Start it from Home.
Every strategy stops. Live offers already at the exchange keep resting until they fill or expire.
Nothing yet. Turn on paper mode to start a record.
This strategy has no live order path.
The kill switch is on. Turn it off on Home before arming anything.
Reads your balance and the markets, and where the venue allows it places one tiny test order and cancels it.
Type LIVE to confirm that this strategy may place real orders with your money.
Meet every red item and tick every acknowledgement first.
Kalshi\'s practice exchange with fake money. Needs a key made on demo.kalshi.co.
A subaccount keeps the bot\'s cash and positions apart from anything you trade by hand.
Material You. Source tags and gains/losses keep their fixed colours.
Strategies wait on mobile data. BTC deep-ITM and reward farming poll every few seconds.
A password-protected file with every order, setting and record. API keys are not included; the Kalshi key cannot leave this phone at all.
This replaces every order, setting and record on this phone with the backup\'s. Strategies come back in paper.
At least 8 characters. It cannot be recovered.
Kill switch: cancel every resting order
No deposits or withdrawals recorded, so this matches equity. Record them under Deposits and withdrawals.
Equity with %1$d recorded deposits and withdrawals taken out: what trading alone did.

The exchanges\' trading APIs do not list transfers, so record them here. Jumps in live equity that settled P&L does not explain are suggested; nothing is recorded until you confirm. Enter withdrawals as negative.

Background test: start it, lock the phone and use it normally. It counts the minutes in which the engine got to run at all. Long silences mean the phone is freezing or killing the app; see dontkillmyapp.com for your model. Silences are expected only while no strategy is on and the engine sleeps until its next alarm.
Ran in %1$s of minutes (%2$d of %3$d), longest silence %4$d min.
Run up to two copies of this strategy in paper with different settings, on the same markets, and compare them with the current settings before changing anything live. Variants never trade live.
Paper records only, settled positions. Paper fills are optimistic for every row alike, so compare rows with each other, not with live.

Once a day the app checks that Kalshi, Polymarket and the BTC price sources still answer in the exact words it relies on: field names, status values, market name shapes and error messages. Read-only. A change is notified as a safety notice before a strategy quietly stops finding markets.
Not run yet. It runs within a day of the engine starting.
Rewards are the program formula\'s estimate, not money received; fill P&L and rebates come from the paper book.
